travelTips: Mandatory biometric registration required on the Uttarakhand Char Dham portal; carry warm thermal clothing even in summer as night temperatures drop near freezing
attractions.accessibility: Requires a 16-km steep mountain trek; ponies, palanquins, and helicopter services available from Phata/Guptkashi
attractions.imageAlt: Kedarnath Temple (Shiva Jyotirlinga) in Char Dham Circuit, Uttarakhand, India

attractions.name: Badrinath Temple (Badri Vishal)
attractions.shortDescription: Primary Vishnu shrine of India's Char Dham at 3,133m between Nar and Narayana mountain ranges, famous for Tapt Kund hot sulfur springs.
attractions.longDescription: Located at an altitude of 3,133 meters along the banks of the Alaknanda River. The supreme shrine of Lord Vishnu, established by Adi Shankaracharya in the 9th century. Features a vibrant rainbow-painted facade, a one-meter black stone (Saligram) idol of Lord Badrinarayan seated in Padmasana posture, and natural natural boiling sulfur hot springs (Tapt Kund) where pilgrims bathe before darshan.
attractions.bestTimeToVisit: May to June & September to October (Closed in winter)
highlights: Primary Vishnu shrine of both All-India Char Dham and Chota Char Dham
Black stone Shaligram idol of Lord Badrinarayan under gold canopy
Natural healing hot sulfur spring pool at Tapt Kund (55°C)
Located just 3 km from Mana, officially India's first/last border village
activities: Bathing in the natural hot spring of Tapt Kund
Darshan of Lord Badri Vishal
Visiting Mana Village (India's first village) and Bheem Pul natural stone bridge
travelTips: Unlike Kedarnath, Badrinath is directly accessible by motorable road via Joshimath; visit Mana village 3 km ahead to see Saraswati River emerge from the mountain
attractions.accessibility: Motorable road to temple entrance; gentle ramps and stone stairs to sanctum
attractions.imageAlt: Badrinath Temple (Badri Vishal) in Char Dham Circuit, Uttarakhand, India

categories.name: Heritage & Architecture
categories.tagline: Millennia of Living History & Architectural Wonders
categories.description: Explore India's peerless architectural legacy spanning 3,000 years—from soaring Dravidian temple gopurams and monolithic rock-cut cave temples to impregnable Rajput hill citadels and symmetrical white marble Mughal mausoleums.

categories.name: Spiritual & Sacred Sites
categories.description: Experience the timeless spiritual heartbeat of India. Journey across the 12 Jyotirlingas, the four supreme Char Dham holy abodes, eternal Ganga Aarti rituals along Varanasi's sacred ghats, and golden gurdwaras serving universal brotherhood.

categories.name: Beaches & Coastal Escapes
categories.tagline: Sun-Kissed Sands, Red Cliffs & Arabian Sea Breezes
categories.description: Discover over 7,500 kilometers of sun-blessed coastline—from the golden crescent bays of Gokarna and dramatic red laterite cliffs of Varkala to the world-famous Marina promenade in Chennai and untouched white sands in Rameswaram.

categories.name: Hill Stations & Mountains
categories.tagline: Misty Valleys, Pine Cathedrals & Snow-Crowned Peaks
categories.description: Ascend to cool mountain retreats cradled by the Himalayas, Western Ghats, and Nilgiris. Ride vintage UNESCO toy trains through tea estates in Ooty and Darjeeling, boat across emerald mountain lakes in Nainital, and walk cloud-draped cliff ridges in Kodaikanal.

categories.name: Wildlife & Nature Reserves
categories.tagline: Royal Bengal Tigers, Asiatic Lions & Wild Elephants
categories.description: Immerse yourself in India's untamed wilderness. Track Royal Bengal Tigers prowling ancient stone ruins in Ranthambore and Jim Corbett, observe the world's last wild Asiatic Lions in Gir, and watch wild elephant herds bathe in the pristine waters of Periyar.

categories.name: Adventure & Thrills
categories.tagline: White-Water Rafting, Desert Safaris & High-Altitude Treks
categories.description: Fuel your wanderlust with high-octane expeditions across varied geography: battle Grade IV Himalayan white-water rapids in Rishikesh, bash 30-meter sand dunes in Jaisalmer's Thar Desert, and trek along boulder-strewn volcanic trails in Hampi.

categories.name: Culinary Heritage & Food Trails
categories.tagline: Royal Nawabi Dastarkhwans, Spicy Chettinad & Street Chaat
categories.description: Embark on an unforgettable sensory feast celebrating India's rich culinary traditions: melt-in-mouth Galouti Kebabs and Awadhi biryanis in Lucknow, fiery pepper crab in Chettinad, buttery pav bhaji on Juhu beach, and aromatic single-estate filter coffees.

categories.name: Culture, Arts & Festivals
categories.tagline: Living Folk Traditions, Classical Dance & World Records
categories.description: Celebrate the colorful kaleidoscope of India's living heritage: witness millions of earthen oil lamps ignite at Ayodhya's Deepotsav, dance at Gujarat's 9-night Navratri Garba, marvel at Kathakali theatre in Kerala, and experience the Pushkar Camel Fair.

itineraries.title: 3 Days in Royal Rajasthan: Jaipur & Pushkar
itineraries.summary: Experience the ultimate 3-day royal circuit through the Pink City of Jaipur and the sacred desert oasis of Pushkar. Marvel at the golden ramparts of Amber Fort, the 953 honeycomb windows of Hawa Mahal, and the tranquil evening ghats of Pushkar Lake.

days.title: Fortresses & Palaces of the Pink City
days.morning: Ascend the cobbled slopes of Amber Fort to explore the Sheesh Mahal mirror palace and Ganesh Pol courtyards.
days.afternoon: Tour the royal Chandra Mahal and courtyards of City Palace; study astronomical stone instruments at UNESCO Jantar Mantar.
days.evening: Capture golden hour photos in front of Hawa Mahal's 953 pink jharokhas; enjoy sunset views over Jaipur from the ramparts of Nahargarh Fort.

days.title: Water Palaces & Old Jaipur Bazaars
days.morning: Admire the floating illusion of Jal Mahal on Man Sagar Lake followed by traditional block printing workshops in Amer village.
days.afternoon: Savor authentic Rajasthani Dal Baati Churma at LMB in Johari Bazaar; shop for Blue Pottery and gemstone jewellery in Bapu Bazaar.
days.evening: Drive through the Aravalli Hills towards the sacred town of Pushkar; check into your desert heritage haveli.

days.title: Sacred Oasis & Desert Sunset in Pushkar
days.morning: Participate in early morning prayers at the 14th-century Jagatpita Brahma Temple and walk barefoot along the sacred 52 stone ghats.
days.afternoon: Browse vibrant handicraft lanes for rose water, camel leather bags, and embroidered textiles; sip sweet falooda lassi by the lake.
days.evening: Embark on a sunset camel safari into the Thar Desert dunes as folk musicians play the ravanahatha under the evening sky.

itineraries.title: 5 Days Tamil Nadu Temple & Heritage Trail
itineraries.summary: Journey through 1,500 years of unbroken Dravidian architectural brilliance: from the sea-carved Pallava monoliths of Mahabalipuram to the 216-foot granite Vimana of Thanjavur's Big Temple and the multi-tiered gopurams of Madurai.

days.title: Colonial Chennai & Pallava Ocean Shore
days.morning: Visit the 7th-century Kapaleeshwarar Temple in Mylapore and historic San Thome Basilica.
days.afternoon: Drive along the scenic East Coast Road (ECR) to UNESCO World Heritage site Mahabalipuram.
days.evening: Explore the monolithic Pancha Rathas and watch the waves crash against the 8th-century Shore Temple at sunset.

days.title: Monolithic Wonders & Descent of the Ganga
days.morning: Marvel at Arjuna's Penance bas-relief and pose by the gravity-defying Krishna's Butter Ball.
days.afternoon: Depart for the ancient Chola imperial capital of Thanjavur across the fertile Kaveri Delta.
days.evening: Arrive in Thanjavur; stroll through the illuminated moat surrounding the Brihadeeswarar Temple complex.

days.title: The Chola Granite Marvel in Thanjavur
days.morning: Tour Brihadeeswarar Temple (Big Temple), studying its 81-ton monolithic granite cupola and thousand-year-old Tamil inscriptions.
days.afternoon: Visit the Thanjavur Maratha Palace, Saraswathi Mahal Library, and royal bronze casting ateliers.
days.evening: Drive through the Chettinad heritage mansion belt towards Madurai; dinner featuring authentic Chettinad pepper chicken.

days.title: The Soul of Madurai & Goddess Meenakshi
days.morning: Enter the magnificent Meenakshi Amman Temple to marvel at the Hall of 1,000 Pillars and sacred Golden Lotus Pond.
days.afternoon: Explore the monumental 82-foot stucco arches of Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace and the historic Gandhi Memorial Museum.
days.evening: Witness the divine 9:00 PM Bed-Chamber palanquin procession inside Meenakshi Temple with nadaswaram music.

days.title: Jasmine Markets & Alagar Hills Departure
days.morning: Walk through Madurai's bustling wholesale jasmine flower market (Madurai Malli) and taste fluffy Idlis at Murugan Idli Shop.
days.afternoon: Take a scenic drive to Alagar Koyil temple nestled in forested hills; taste sacred pepper dosai prasad.
days.evening: Transfer to Madurai Airport or Railway Station for onward travel.

itineraries.title: 5 Days Kerala Backwaters, Tea Hills & Coast
itineraries.summary: Discover God's Own Country: explore colonial Portuguese and Dutch history in Fort Kochi, breathe fresh cardamom air in the mist-wrapped tea plantations of Munnar, and cruise silent emerald lagoons on a private thatched houseboat in Alleppey.

days.title: Colonial Charm of Fort Kochi
days.morning: Stroll along Fort Kochi to watch fishermen operate the 14th-century Chinese Fishing Nets against the morning tide.
days.afternoon: Visit the 16th-century Mattancherry Palace with its Ramayana murals and browse antique shops in historic Jew Town.
days.evening: Attend an authentic Kathakali classical dance performance with live makeup demonstration; dine on fresh grilled seafood.

days.title: Ascent into the Misty Tea Hills of Munnar
days.morning: Drive through lush Western Ghats mountain roads, stopping at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls.
days.afternoon: Arrive in Munnar; walk through aromatic cardamom, cinnamon, and pepper spice gardens.
days.evening: Check into a cliffside tea estate bungalow; sip fresh single-estate brew as evening fog blankets the hills.

days.title: Tea Plantations & Endangered Nilgiri Tahr
days.morning: Board the eco-safari bus at Eravikulam National Park to spot the rare Nilgiri Tahr grazing near Anamudi Peak.
days.afternoon: Tour the Tata Tea Museum for an artisan tea tasting session and live CTC manufacturing demonstration.
days.evening: Enjoy pedal boating at Mattupetty Dam reservoir and panoramic views from Top Station looking into Tamil Nadu.

days.title: Houseboat Living on Alleppey Backwaters
days.morning: Scenic descent from the mountains towards the palm-fringed backwater hub of Alappuzha (Alleppey).
days.afternoon: Board your private luxury thatched Kettuvallam houseboat; glide silently through Vembanad Lake and narrow palm canals.
days.evening: Feast on freshly caught Pearl Spot (Karimeen) fish and Kerala Sadya prepared by your onboard chef under starry skies.

days.title: Sunrise Canal Cruise & Departure
days.morning: Wake up to mist drifting over water lilies; take a quiet morning canoe ride through rural village coir-making canals.
days.afternoon: Disembark from the houseboat; stroll along Alappuzha Beach and its historic 160-year-old colonial pier.
days.evening: Transfer to Cochin International Airport (COK) for your flight home.

itineraries.title: 4 Days Spiritual Heartland: Varanasi, Ayodhya & Lucknow
itineraries.summary: A profound spiritual and cultural odyssey across the holy rivers Ganga and Saryu to the Nawabi capital of Lucknow. Experience dawn boat rides along Varanasi's 84 ghats, darshan at the grand new Ram Mandir in Ayodhya, and Awadhi culinary royalty.

days.title: The Eternal City of Kashi (Varanasi)
days.morning: Sunrise wooden boat ride along the 84 sacred ghats; witness morning snan and classical Subah-e-Banaras ragas at Assi Ghat.
days.afternoon: Walk through the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor to take darshan of the gold-spired Shiva Jyotirlinga.
days.evening: Witness the magnificent choreographed evening Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti from stone steps; release floating marigold lamps.

days.title: Buddha's Sarnath & Road to Ayodhya
days.morning: Visit Sarnath (10 km away) to meditate by the 43-meter Dhamek Stupa and see the Ashokan Lion Capital at the museum.
days.afternoon: Scenic highway drive or Vande Bharat Express ride to the holy city of Ayodhya on the sacred Saryu River.
days.evening: Attend the serene evening Saryu River Aarti at Naya Ghat; walk the illuminated pathways of Ram Ki Paidi.

days.title: Sacred Ayodhya & Shri Ram Janmabhoomi
days.morning: Climb the 76 steps to Hanuman Garhi fortress temple before sacred darshan at the magnificent new Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir.
days.afternoon: Visit the ornate Bundeli palace temple of Kanak Bhawan; sample traditional Ayodhya pedas and rabri.
days.evening: Drive on the Purvanchal Expressway to the regal city of Lucknow; check into your heritage hotel.

days.title: Nawabi Heritage & Awadhi Gastronomy in Lucknow
days.morning: Navigate the mysterious 3D labyrinth of Bhulbhulaiya atop the monumental Bara Imambara and admire Rumi Darwaza.
days.afternoon: Walk through the British Residency ruins; shop for authentic GI-tagged Chikankari embroidery in Hazratganj.
days.evening: Feast on melt-in-mouth Galouti and Tunday Kebabs with Ulte Tawe Ka Paratha in Aminabad before departure.

itineraries.title: 4 Days Karnataka Heritage: Hampi & Badami
itineraries.summary: Explore the golden ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire at UNESCO World Heritage Hampi, and the 6th-century Chalukyan rock-cut cave temples of Badami overlooking emerald Agastya Lake.

days.title: Sacred Ruins & Boulder Landscapes of Hampi
days.morning: Receive morning blessings from Lakshmi the elephant at Virupaksha Temple; explore ancient Hampi Bazaar ruins.
days.afternoon: Hike up boulder-strewn Hemakuta Hill to view early Chalukyan shrines and the giant Kadalekalu Ganesha monolithic statue.
days.evening: Climb Matanga Hill for an unforgettable 360-degree sunset view over the Tungabhadra River and ruined empire.

days.title: The Stone Chariot & Royal Enclosure
days.morning: Tour the Vittala Temple complex, marveling at the world-famous Stone Chariot and testing the acoustic musical pillars.
days.afternoon: Explore the royal Zenana Enclosure, the Indo-Islamic Lotus Mahal, and the 11 grand domed Elephant Stables.
days.evening: Coracle boat ride on the rushing waters of the Tungabhadra River; cafe hopping in bohemian Sanapur village.

days.title: Rock-Cut Caves of Badami & Agastya Lake
days.morning: Drive to Badami; climb through the four 6th-century rock-cut cave temples chiseled into soaring red sandstone cliffs.
days.afternoon: Admire the 18-armed dancing Nataraja in Cave 1 and colossal Vishnu sculptures in Cave 3 overlooking Agastya Lake.
days.evening: Walk around the quiet shores of Agastya Lake to watch sunset reflect off the water plinth of Bhutanatha Temple.

days.title: UNESCO Pattadakal & Cradle of Temple Architecture
days.morning: Visit the UNESCO World Heritage temple complex at Pattadakal (22 km) displaying early Dravidian and Nagara temple fusions.
days.afternoon: Explore the historic 5th-century rock temples of Aihole (Durga Temple and Lad Khan Temple).
days.evening: Return to Hubballi or Bengaluru for onward travel.

itineraries.title: 5 Days Devbhoomi Uttarakhand: Rishikesh, Nainital & Corbett
itineraries.summary: The ultimate Himalayan sampler: from holy evening Ganga Aartis and white-water rapids in Rishikesh and Haridwar to wild Bengal Tiger safaris in Jim Corbett and boating on emerald Naini Lake.

days.title: Holy River & Evening Aarti in Haridwar
days.morning: Take the cable car up to Mansa Devi Temple on Bilwa Parvat overlooking the Ganga valley.
days.afternoon: Walk through the bustling Moti Bazaar; taste hot kachoris and rabri jalebi.
days.evening: Secure stone seats at Har Ki Pauri for the awe-inspiring evening Ganga Aarti with flaming brass lamps and floating diyas.

days.title: Yoga & White-Water Rafting in Rishikesh
days.morning: Experience thrilling Grade III/IV white-water river rafting from Shivpuri, navigating Roller Coaster and Golf Course rapids.
days.afternoon: Walk across Ram Jhula; explore The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia) with its psychedelic murals.
days.evening: Attend the serene sunset Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan facing the majestic Shiva statue in the river.

days.title: Tiger Safari in India's Oldest National Park
days.morning: Scenic drive through the Shivalik foothills to Jim Corbett National Park.
days.afternoon: Board an open-top 4x4 Gypsy safari into Bijrani or Jhirna zones; track Bengal Tigers, Asian elephants, and spotted deer.
days.evening: Relax around a bonfire at your riverside jungle resort along the Kosi River.

days.title: Emerald Mountain Lake in Nainital
days.morning: Drive through Kumaoni pine ridges to the picturesque hill station of Nainital (6,350 ft).
days.afternoon: Yachting and pedal boating on the emerald waters of Naini Lake; visit the sacred lakeside Naina Devi Temple.
days.evening: Take the aerial ropeway cable car to Snow View Point for vistas of Mount Nanda Devi; stroll the lively Mall Road.

days.title: Himalayan Viewpoints & Departure
days.morning: Horseback ride or nature hike to Tiffin Top (Dorothy's Seat) for 360-degree vistas over Kumaon hills.
days.afternoon: Shop for aromatic hand-carved decorative candles and fresh fruit jams at Tibetan Market.
days.evening: Transfer to Kathgodam railway station or Pantnagar airport for departure.
